questions_and_answers.assessment_review: Original sound recognition, pronunciation and spelling practice. The 35 entries correspond to Appendix 1; these short marks are not official pronunciation marks. Higher reading aloud is assessed holistically for pronunciation (5 marks), with a separate 10-mark conversation. Dictation is 10 marks; use the sample scheme for its complete-sentence marking rules.
